name: Waldheim
beschreibung: The guest house Waldheim is located in the centre of St. Anton am Arlberg, just a few minutes' walk from the valley station of the Galzigbahn cable car. The house combines traditional Tyrolean hospitality with modern comfort – the rooms are functionally furnished and feature complimentary Wi-Fi. Regional dishes are served in the on-site restaurant, and the hotel bar is the perfect place to wind down at the end of the day. A dedicated ski storage room with boot warmers provides ample space for sports equipment.
